events.head: Check dashboard route, weekly job, files, git state and runbook
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; echo "--- http"; curl -s -o /tmp/pipe.html -w "%{http_code} %{size_download}\n" "http://localhost:8899/pipeline?v=$(date +%s)"; grep -o '<h2[^>]*>[^<]*' /tmp/pipe.html | head -20; echo "--- tags"; grep -o 'class="tag[^"]*"' /tmp/pipe.html | sort | uniq -c; echo "--- launchctl"; launchctl print gui/$(id -u)/com.tantra.pipeline-weekly 2>&1 | grep -E "state|path|last exit|program" | head; echo "--- files"; ls -la workshop-plan/pipeline/ workshop-plan/pipeline/snapshots 2>&1 | head -30; ls workshop-plan/ops/com.tantra.pipeline-weekly.plist ~/Library/Launc
